# **1\. System Overview**

The HOPE Inc. HR Management System is a web-based application for managing employees, jobs, departments, and job histories. It supports three user types with different levels of access.

| User Type | Access Level | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **SUPERADMIN** | Full Access | Can do everything including activating admins and managing all users |
| **ADMIN** | HR Management | Can manage employees, jobs, departments, job history, and reports. Cannot modify SUPERADMIN accounts. |
| **USER** | Read Only | Can view active employees, jobs, departments, and job history. Cannot add, edit, or delete. |

*📝 Note: All new accounts start as INACTIVE and must be activated by a SUPERADMIN before they can log in.*

# **2\. Getting Started — Registration**

New users must register before they can access the system. Two methods are supported.

## **2.1 Email Registration**

1. Open the application in your browser and navigate to the Register page.

2. Enter your email address in the Email field.

3. Enter a password (minimum 6 characters).

4. Click the Register button.

5. You will see a confirmation message. Your account is now INACTIVE and awaiting activation.

![][image1]

*📝 Note: You will NOT be able to log in until a SUPERADMIN activates your account.*

## **2.2 Google OAuth Registration**

6. On the Register page, click Sign in with Google.

7. Select your Google account and complete the consent screen.

8. You will be redirected back to the application.

9. Your account is automatically created as INACTIVE and awaits activation.

   

![][image2]

![][image3]

# **2\. Getting Started — Login**

## **3.1 Email Login**

10. Navigate to the Login page.

11. Enter your registered email and password.

12. Click Login.

13. If your account is ACTIVE, you will be redirected to the Dashboard.

    

![][image4]

## 

## 

## 

## 

## 

## **3.2 Google Login**

14. On the Login page, click Sign in with Google.

15. Select your Google account.

16. If your account is ACTIVE, you will be redirected to the Dashboard.

## **3.3 Login Guard**

If your account is INACTIVE, you will see the following message and will not be able to proceed:

*"Your account is pending activation by an administrator."*

*✅ Tip: Contact your SUPERADMIN to activate your account before attempting to log in again.*

# **4\. Dashboard**

After logging in, you are taken to the Dashboard. This is the home screen of the system.

![][image5]

From the Dashboard you can navigate to all modules using the sidebar or navigation menu. The modules available to you depend on your user type.

# **5\. Employee Management**

The Employee Management module allows you to view and manage employee records.

## **5.1 Viewing the Employee List**

17. Click Employees in the navigation menu.

18. The employee list displays all active employees.

19. USER accounts see only ACTIVE employees due to system-level access controls.

## **5.2 Adding an Employee (ADMIN / SUPERADMIN only)**

20. On the Employee List page, click Add Employee.

21. Fill in the required fields: First Name, Last Name, Department, Job.

22. Click Save to create the record.

## **5.3 Editing an Employee (ADMIN / SUPERADMIN only)**

23. On the Employee List, click the Edit icon next to the employee.

24. Update the relevant fields.

25. Click Save to apply changes.

## **5.4 Viewing Employee Details**

26. Click on an employee's name to open their detail page.

27. The detail page shows personal info and their full job history.

## **5.5 Soft-Deleting an Employee (ADMIN / SUPERADMIN only)**

28. On the Employee List, click the Delete icon next to the employee.

29. Confirm the deletion when prompted.

30. The employee is moved to Deleted Items and hidden from USER view.

*📝 Note: The system uses soft-delete — records are never permanently removed. They can be recovered from the Deleted Items page.*

# **6\. Job Management**

The Job Management module allows you to manage job titles in the system.

## **6.1 Viewing the Job List**

31. Click Jobs in the navigation menu.

32. All active job titles are listed.

## **6.2 Adding a Job (ADMIN / SUPERADMIN only)**

33. On the Job List page, click Add Job.

34. Enter the Job Title.

35. Click Save.

## **6.3 Editing a Job (ADMIN / SUPERADMIN only)**

36. Click the Edit icon next to the job.

37. Update the job title.

38. Click Save.

# **7\. Department Management**

The Department Management module allows you to manage company departments.

## **7.1 Viewing Departments**

39. Click Departments in the navigation menu.

40. All active departments are listed.

## **7.2 Adding a Department (ADMIN / SUPERADMIN only)**

41. Click Add Department.

42. Enter the Department Name.

43. Click Save.

## **7.3 Editing a Department (ADMIN / SUPERADMIN only)**

44. Click the Edit icon next to the department.

45. Update the name.

46. Click Save.

# **8\. Job History**

The Job History module tracks an employee's career progression within the company.

## **8.1 Viewing Job History**

47. Navigate to an Employee's detail page.

48. The Job History section lists all job assignments with dates.

49. USER accounts can view job history for ACTIVE employees only.

## **8.2 Adding a Job History Entry (ADMIN / SUPERADMIN only)**

50. On the Employee Detail page, click Add Job History.

51. Select the Job and enter the Start Date.

52. Click Save.

*📝 Note: When an employee is soft-deleted, their job history is automatically hidden from USER view. It is restored when the employee is recovered.*

# **9\. Reports**

The Reports module is available to ADMIN and SUPERADMIN users only. It provides three report types.

| Report | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Employee Report** | Lists all employees with their current job and department |
| **Department Report** | Lists all departments with employee counts |
| **Job Report** | Lists all job titles with assigned employee counts |

## **9.1 Generating a Report**

53. Click Reports in the navigation menu.

54. Select the report type you want to generate.

55. The report is displayed on screen.

# **10\. Deleted Items**

The Deleted Items page is available to ADMIN and SUPERADMIN users. It shows all soft-deleted employee records.

## **10.1 Viewing Deleted Items**

56. Click Deleted Items in the navigation menu.

57. All soft-deleted employees are listed here.

  


## **10.2 Recovering an Employee**

58. On the Deleted Items page, find the employee to recover.

59. Click the Recover button next to their name.

60. The employee's record\_status is set back to ACTIVE.

61. The employee reappears in the main Employee List.

62. Their job history is automatically restored for all users.

*✅ Tip: Recovery is immediate — the employee will appear in USER views right away after recovery.*

# **11\. User Management & Admin Activation**

The User Management page and Admin Activation feature are available to SUPERADMIN only.

## **11.1 Viewing User Management**

63. Click Admin in the navigation menu.

64. All registered users are listed with their user type and status.

## **11.2 Activating a New User**

65. On the User Management page, find the INACTIVE user.

66. Click Activate next to their name.

67. Their account status changes to ACTIVE.

68. The user can now log in successfully.

## **11.3 SUPERADMIN Protection**

ADMIN users cannot modify SUPERADMIN accounts. The edit controls for SUPERADMIN rows are hidden from ADMIN view, and any direct database modification attempt is blocked by Row Level Security (RLS) policies.

*📝 Note: Only SUPERADMIN accounts can activate or deactivate other users. ADMIN accounts do not have this right (R16).*

# **12\. User Rights Reference**

The following table shows which actions are available to each user type.

| Action | SUPERADMIN | ADMIN | USER |
| :---- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| View Employee List | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Add Employee | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Edit Employee | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Soft-Delete Employee | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| View Deleted Items | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Recover Deleted Employee | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| View Job History | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Add Job History Entry | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| View Department List | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Add Department | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Edit Department | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| View Job List | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Add Job | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Edit Job | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| View Reports | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Activate/Deactivate Users | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| View User Management | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |

# **13\. Troubleshooting**

| Problem | Cause | Solution |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Cannot log in after registering | Account is INACTIVE | Contact your SUPERADMIN to activate your account |
| Alert: 'Your account is pending activation' | Login guard blocked INACTIVE account | Wait for SUPERADMIN to activate your account |
| Cannot see Add/Edit buttons | USER accounts have read-only access | Contact SUPERADMIN if you need elevated access |
| Employee missing from list | Employee may be soft-deleted | ADMIN: check Deleted Items page to recover |
| Job history not visible for employee | Employee is soft-deleted | Recover the employee from Deleted Items |
| Reports page not accessible | USER accounts cannot access reports | Contact SUPERADMIN to upgrade your account type |
| Google login not working | OAuth not configured or redirect URL mismatch | Contact your system administrator |
